description: Implementation class for Note reading operations, providing methods to retrieve notes by ID and resource type, mapping database rows to NoteData objects, and handling specific note type resource conditions.

classes.name: NoteReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing NoteReadPlatformService, providing methods to retrieve notes from database.

classes.name: NoteMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation that maps SQL query result rows to NoteData objects.

methods.name: retrieveNote
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by ID, resource ID, and note type. Throws NoteNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: retrieveNotesByResource
methods.description: Retrieves all notes associated with a specific resource ID and type.

methods.name: getResourceCondition
methods.description: Builds SQL condition string and parameters for querying notes based on resource type and ID.
